verdict.rationale: There are only glancing signs of custom controls. The framework-removal docs say controls can contain "custom content" that is preserved. The Fieldwork page invites you to "describe your control" and have AI agents collect and validate evidence for it, which hints at user-defined controls with evidence collection. Neither source documents creating custom frameworks. Missing for 10: documented creation of custom frameworks, explicit custom control authoring alongside built-in controls, user-defined automated tests, configurable evidence requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
